content:
After nine days, Muse has officially landed on Mac. Click here to download.

Meta AI has just launched a brand-new app for iPhone called Meta Muse. With an interface design similar to Grok Bot, Muse is a personal AI agent that handles tasks on your behalf.

This echoes the recent trend among AI companies to anthropomorphise their AI agents, mimicking chat interfaces to make them more approachable and easier to understand.

Muse can also be accessed via muse.ai on the Mac web version. The system allows customisation of agent names and avatars for a more personalised experience.

Unlike other systems, Muse is free to use, but comes with a weekly quota; paid customers can unlock higher usage.

Learn more about the new Muse agent design and its safety features here. Muse is now available on the App Store for iPhone users.

The app is currently only available in the US, with more countries to follow shortly.

Last month, Meta AI also launched a more feature-rich desktop app for Mac.

In the same month Muse debuted, Siri AI also made its appearance, seemingly as Apple's upgrade to its voice assistant to keep pace with the chatbot era. While Siri AI can perform some actions, it has yet to become a complete agent system on par with what OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceXAI and Meta AI have demonstrated.

Get the most out of your Apple products.
